methodology: Per-call classification of edit_file arguments by presence/absence of old_string and new_string keys after JSON parsing of the harness-recorded tool_calls[].arguments field; back-to-back duplicate detection compares consecutive edit_file/write_file calls (same function name + identical parsed arguments) with no other tool call between them.
notes: missing_old_string_only (new_string present, old_string absent) is the cleanest symptom of the edit_file argument-loss failure (see writeup Section 3): the call carries a replacement but the match target was lost. Mechanism is an open question (the naive colon-split parser hypothesis was falsified; see Section 3.2-3.3).

edit_file_any_missing_required_arg matches the broader 'malformed' definition used by scripts/eval_matrix/mechanism_check.py elsewhere in this project (any required argument absent, for any reason) -- do not conflate the two percentages when citing.
